metadata.title: Clicked like a confused cat and actually got a kill? Valorant logic is broken again
metadata.description:
Clicked like I wasn’t even trying
Enemy probably questioning their entire life
Did NOT deserve that one but I’ll take the chaos
If your aim’s mostly accidental, welcome to the madness
